newsitem.title: CHINA: China '97 fixed asset investment seen up 18.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: China '97 fixed asset investment seen up 18.6 pct.

text.p: China's fixed asset investment is expected to rise 18.6 percent to reach 2.813 trillion yuan ($338.9 billion) in 1997, the China News Service said on Saturday.

CNS said experts predicted state enterprises would continue to lag behind other, more vibrant sectors of the economy, and may see their overall share of fixed asset investment shrink to about 50 percent of the country's total.
The agency did not give comparative figures for 1996.

By contrast, the collective sector -- which includes joint ventures -- should see fixed asset investment grow by about 20 percent in 1997, making up about 16.7 percent of the national total, CNS said.
It added that capital input for technological modernisation projects was expected to grow by 18.6 percent this year, while real estate projects would absorb 26 percent more investment.
State media had earlier predicted that China's fixed asset investment would grow to 2.775 billion yuan in 1997, an increase of 17.6 percent from 2.36 billion yuan in 1996.
